shortDescription: MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 4 Patwari and other post combined recruitment test 2026 admit card is now available. Candidates can download their admit card from the official MPESB portal.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has released the MP Group 2 Sub Group 4 Patwari and Other Post Combined Recruitment Test 2026 Admit Card.

The recruitment exam is scheduled to start from 22 September 2026. Candidates can download their admit card from the official MPESB portal using their registration credentials.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 04/08/2026
  • Last date to apply online: 21/08/2026
  • Last date for fee payment: 21/08/2026
  • Correction last date: 23/08/2026
  • Exam date start: 22/09/2026
  • Admit card available: 18/09/2026
  • Result status: Notified soon

Vacancy details

  • UR: 608
  • EWS: 207
  • OBC: 613
  • SC: 274
  • ST: 404
  • Total: 2106

Always download the admit card only from the official MPESB website and carefully verify your exam date, district and reporting time.
